content.title: Shoreline Task Loop | Camp Prep, Wave Recovery and Route Return
content.summary: An adult island ecologist carries a sampling kettle to the shore, braces through one wave and returns along her footprints. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject, one carried tool, one camp anchor and one shoreline route establish the task. + A complete preparation action precedes departure with the same tool. + The route from camp to water remains visible through landmarks or footprints. + Exactly one environmental interruption causes a readable brace while tool possession and identity persist. + The subject visibly recovers and returns along the established route to the same camp terminal state.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one clearly adult original island ecologist with tied black hair, a loose sand shirt, olive shorts and one silver sampling kettle beside a canvas beach shelter at sunrise. At the waterline she lowers the kettle once and keeps shelter, footprints and shoreline direction readable in the wider frame. She steadies, checks the closed kettle and follows the same footprints back toward the canvas shelter until both adult and camp share the terminal wide view.
required_anchors: One clearly adult subject, one carried tool, one camp anchor and one shoreline route establish the task.
A complete preparation action precedes departure with the same tool.
Exactly one environmental interruption causes a readable brace while tool possession and identity persist.
The subject visibly recovers and returns along the established route to the same camp terminal state.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult island ecologist carries a sampling kettle to the shore, braces through one wave and returns along her footprints. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先让成年人物在固定营地完成一项带工具的晨间准备，再携带同一器具沿清楚路线走到水边；一次海浪打断任务后，人物保持器具并恢复站立，随后沿原方向返回营地。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject, one carried tool, one camp anchor and one shoreline route establish the task.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject, one carried tool, one camp anchor and one shoreline route establish the task."

invariants.rule: A complete preparation action precedes departure with the same tool.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A complete preparation action precedes departure with the same tool."

invariants.rule: The route from camp to water remains visible through landmarks or footprints.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The route from camp to water remains visible through landmarks or footprints."

invariants.rule: Exactly one environmental interruption causes a readable brace while tool possession and identity persist.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Exactly one environmental interruption causes a readable brace while tool possession and identity persist."

invariants.rule: The subject visibly recovers and returns along the established route to the same camp terminal state.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The subject visibly recovers and returns along the established route to the same camp terminal state."

slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
